searchText: Why are some DepositMessages in blocks failing the BLS verification step from process_deposit()? Example from block at slot 7776: DepositMessage SSZ: 8e62ced1f9723cebf4135f47a7bf268ebde98ba87ba14337f10e47317292eb90709dfbc769f3fb9be49ba719969f37550070c635ecab899b4c868eef3a6f34ba15429b543f02dd9c925dc128509008490020bcbe00000000 signing_root: 0x05392a477c6edbf97f5a13d93b30daa6a8fde9e9ecf59f40bd29ea0dc0e15c08 Are you mixing in fork version/domain wrong? Deposits are a special case because they will need to pass BLS verification regardless of fork Also, `.hex()` is helpful for pretty debug outputs I'm executing the unchanged pyspec, so should be using the correct fork version & domain info Schlesi may have a different genesis fork version? Not sure there. It’s permitted that deposits fail BLS verification. The smart contract doesn’t verify sigs so the sigs are basically random internet data. Right! This is definitely NOT a client bug True, some user may have messed up Yeah I’ve seen people writing their own tools and getting it wrong Expensive mistake, good that it's test eth Why would anyone use an untested tool, even if it's just test ETH? 🧐 Goerli is a testnet Also if you run an older version of the spec you’ll get invalid sigs Never underestimate recklessness of testnet users Haha, guilty 😂 We messed up the genesis fork version and a few of our deposits are duff. Now fixed and fingers crossed for becoming active soon... Yay for testnets!!! Mystery solved Ah ok! More and more tempted to expand my deposit tracking code. Both for <@340345049063882753> and <@573787335796326400> . Good to have some insight in who is making deposits, if they are invalid, and how long activation takes I don’t care how well tested the real deposit tool is - I don’t think I could survive this much suspense with real eth. 🙂 Nimbus failed schlesi sync on this - https://github.com/status-im/nim-beacon-chain/issues/989 - turns out we were a little too strict on deposits Glad I could cause trouble for someone other than myself. 🙂

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: Are you mixing in fork version/domain wrong? Deposits are a special case because they will need to pass BLS verification regardless of fork

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: Also, `.hex()` is helpful for pretty debug outputs

excerpts.author: adiasg
excerpts.content: I'm executing the unchanged pyspec, so should be using the correct fork version & domain info

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: Schlesi may have a different genesis fork version? Not sure there.

excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content: It’s permitted that deposits fail BLS verification. The smart contract doesn’t verify sigs so the sigs are basically random internet data.

excerpts.author: adiasg
excerpts.content: Right! This is definitely NOT a client bug

excerpts.author: protolambda
excerpts.content: True, some user may have messed up
